purpose: build the first practical standard post-training corpus, deliberately CFE/LHIT-informed but not a CFE experimental arm
research_basis: LIMO arXiv:2502.03387 — small difficult/diverse high-quality SFT can strongly elicit reasoning
s1 arXiv:2501.19393 — 1K examples selected for difficulty/diversity/quality can materially improve reasoning
Reasoning Quality Emerges Early / TEMP arXiv:2606.26797 — naive reasoning-SFT scaling can degrade performance; difficulty/diversity selection can be far more token efficient

Nemotron-Cascade 2 arXiv:2603.19220 — modern post-training mixes math, code, science, tools, software engineering, multi-turn chat and instruction following; large-scale recipe is donor evidence, not a scale prescription for this 4B/6GB regime

A0_CORE_SEED.goal: prove mixture, rendering, ordering, and regression safety on first learner

A1_EXPANDED_STANDARD.authorization: only after A0 local phenotype/eval result is positive or clearly informative

render_modes.ANSWER_ONLY: learner sees task/context and assistant answer/tool action content; stored reasoning_content is excluded from loss/render
render_modes.BOUNDED_REASONING: include source reasoning only when it falls within lane-specific bounds and passes quality gates
render_modes.FULL_TRAJECTORY: preserve messages, tools and observations in order; reasoning remains lane/budget controlled
render_modes.LHIT_WHOLE_EPISODE: preserve complete causally dependent multi-turn episode; do not crop turns merely to fit a token cap

competitive_code.reason: pilot long-CoT dominates dose; final executable code is the primary supervised target
competitive_code.verification_priority: compile/sample-test or stronger verifier before reasoning-rich admission

math.over_16k: do not train full trace in A0; use verified concise solution/final-answer view if semantically complete, otherwise quarantine
math.selection_priority: verifier support + difficulty + diversity + support coverage, never length alone

general_reasoning_science.over_16k: quarantine or answer-only only when answer remains complete and useful

instruction_following.priority: constraint adherence, correction, structured output, concise competence

agent_tool.rule: tool calls and observations are preserved when causally required; excessive private reasoning may be omitted without deleting tool/action history
agent_tool.failed_trace_rule: failed traces are not positive SFT unless explicitly qualified as recovery examples

deep_research.rule: preserve evidence/tool chronology; teacher reasoning is not factual ground truth; prefer episodes that cross-check and recover from weak searches

lhit_multiturn.rule: if causal history cannot fit whole, quarantine for later long-context stage rather than flatten/crop away the dependency

swe.reason: protected SWE-bench-family evaluation contamination must be resolved before training admission

cross_cutting_requirements.lhit_invariant_coverage: actively select across Capybara, agent and research sources; no fixed Capybara-label quota
cross_cutting_requirements.cfe_support: avoid narrow source/domain support; prefer examples that distinguish plausible rival rules
cross_cutting_requirements.contrast: retain useful correct/repair, changed-condition, isomorph/anti-isomorph and evidence-sufficient/insufficient contrasts where learner-visible
cross_cutting_requirements.currentness: include state-change/revision examples where later evidence changes the correct conclusion
cross_cutting_requirements.composition: include composition tasks but tag separately; primitive quality does not substitute for composition evidence

selection_order: evaluation contamination pass or non-protected source

standard_ordering.description: at each step choose the capability/source group furthest below its cumulative target share, while avoiding immediate same-source repetition and preserving whole multi-turn/tool episodes
standard_ordering.claim: engineering-informed standard ordering only; no CFE causal claim

hard_laws: DO NOT PAY 100K TOKENS FOR A TRACE MERELY BECAUSE IT EXISTS
KEEP REASONING AND FINAL ANSWER SEPARABLE
LHIT HISTORY MAY NOT BE CROPPED UNTIL ITS CAUSAL DEPENDENCY IS PROVEN IRRELEVANT
A0 IS A PROBE OF THE STANDARD RECIPE, NOT THE FINAL CORPUS
